versions.content: When a call to an Rte_Rips_<Plugin>_NotifyCopyTxData API exists within an Rte_LdComCbkCopyTxData callback, the RTE shall pass through the following IN parameters from the outer callback function context as parameters to the Rte_Rips_<Plugin>_NotifyCopyTxData call: • info • retry The variables passed to the Rte_Rips_<Plugin>_NotifyCopyTxData shall be unchanged from the parameters passed to the Rte_LdComCbkCopyTxData call- back.
